title: 2057. Smallest Index With Equal Value

examples.explanation: i=0: 0 mod 10 = 0 == nums[0]. i=1: 1 mod 10 = 1 == nums[1]. i=2: 2 mod 10 = 2 == nums[2]. All indices have i mod 10 == nums[i], so we return the smallest index 0.
i=0: 0 mod 10 = 0 != nums[0]. i=1: 1 mod 10 = 1 != nums[1]. i=2: 2 mod 10 = 2 == nums[2]. i=3: 3 mod 10 = 3 != nums[3]. 2 is the only index which has i mod 10 == nums[i].
No index satisfies i mod 10 == nums[i].
